disposition: Caller-supplied MobileNetV3-small log-mel rate-regressor readiness blocker; no implementation, adapter, checkpoint or result.

documented_provenance.conclusion_recorded: The full five-fold run underperformed the constant-fold-mean baseline on every aggregate metric; this is a poor fit on this single-meeting cohort, not a product validation.

exact_blockers.required_action: Supply five fold state dicts (or one checkpoint plus a bit-exact retraining recipe) with SHA-256, byte counts and an explicit license/terms decision for the trained weights.
exact_blockers.statement: The report references mobilenet_rate_optimized_last_fold.pt, but the file is absent. The recipe saves only the final fold; checkpoints for folds 0-4 do not exist, so the OOF predictions cannot be reproduced from stored weights.

exact_blockers.required_action: Provide a locked offline runtime with exact versions, wheel hashes, install/import digest, deterministic settings, seed 20261101 and 4/1 threads, and record a clean import.
exact_blockers.statement: No pinned runtime exists. The historical environment data/envs/sylnet-py310 is absent; the available Python 3.10.13 interpreter has no torch, torchvision or librosa. Librosa, NumPy, SciPy and SoundFile versions and wheel hashes are not recorded, and torch.use_deterministic_algorithms was not set.

exact_blockers.required_action: Persist the 24x64 log-mel cache with SHA-256/byte count, or pin the exact front-end implementation and reproduce the cache digest from the qualified corpus.
exact_blockers.statement: The log-mel cache was held in memory and never persisted. The documented front end depends on the exact librosa version and defaults; no cache bytes or output digest are available.

exact_blockers.required_action: Freeze a rights-cleared, multi-meeting, speaker-disjoint rate cohort with checked labels, language/speaker groups, source-timestamp provenance and reviewed corpus/dictionary terms.
exact_blockers.statement: The historical cohort is one AMI EN2003a meeting with 210 four-second windows. Its syllable labels are CMUdict first pronunciations, not human nuclei; AMI, annotation and CMUdict terms are unreviewed.

exact_blockers.required_action: Reproduce the fixed five-fold protocol on the qualified cohort with a frozen scorer, baseline, fold stability, finite-output scan and adverse/missing/nonfinite controls.
exact_blockers.statement: No local CV or control result exists. The recorded full run gave MAE 2.757 against a 1.160 constant baseline with four negative fold correlations; that is provenance context, not a reproduced result.

exact_blockers.required_action: Complete the Rate profile, measure target-device paced timing/resources/deadlines, and open a separate OFF-by-default provider intake after all prior gates clear.
exact_blockers.statement: No Rate-profile, listening, target-device timing, provider or release evidence exists. The historical 5.37 ms/clip is model-only CPU batch context on another host, not a device deadline or product claim.

non_claims: No MobileNetV3 weight, trained fold checkpoint or state dict is present.
No PyTorch, torchvision or librosa runtime is imported or executed.
No audio signal, feature array, model weight or log-mel cache is read or decoded.
No transcript text, syllable label or prediction is extracted, used or scored.
No cross-validation, accuracy, timing or baseline result is reproduced.
No listening, device timing, benchmark, pipeline or release claim is made.
No provider, registry, descriptor, public ABI, shared build or CI change exists.
A syllables/second estimate is not a preferred speed factor or a TSM setting.
The historical negative result is provenance context, not a local result or a product decision.

quality_outcomes.evidence: The recorded OOF MAE/RMSE/bias is provenance only; no local score was reproduced.
The recorded negative fold correlations are not recomputed; no per-fold predictions exist locally.
The recorded baseline is not reproduced or compared locally.
No model was executed, so finite-output, adverse, missing and nonfinite-input controls do not exist.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: The candidate is a rate estimator, not a TSM renderer; no source/output mapping or duration result exists.
No rendered output, F0/transient metric or listening result exists for a MobileNetV3 rate estimate.
No playback chain, queue, fill/flush or buffering measurement exists.
No 1x or rate-change comparison exists; syllables/second is not a speed factor.
The historical pilot is one AMI meeting of speech; no unfamiliar speech, music, silence or language coverage was tested.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Include unfamiliar speech, music and silence.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: No stream, rebuffer, clock-drift or partial-window behavior was measured.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Include rebuffer, drift and the final partial window.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: No pause/filler controller, source-timestamp mapping or speech-preservation measurement exists.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Keep pause or filler decisions tied to source timestamps and measure speech preservation.

rate_profile_requirements.evidence: No preference/acceptability labels or rate-to-speed policy exists; none is inferred from the historical score.
rate_profile_requirements.requirement: Map estimated rate to a reviewed preferred-speed policy.

release_gates.reopen_condition: Stage the exact torchvision and dependency source/license/notice bundles, record the script revision and terms, and complete an independent license review.
release_gates.statement: The historical training script is pinned, but no torchvision 0.17.2 source tree, complete license/notice bundle or reviewed product-use decision is staged.
release_gates.title: source_revision_and_license_provenance

release_gates.reopen_condition: Supply all five fold state dicts with SHA-256/byte counts, or a single checkpoint plus a bit-exact retraining recipe, and verify them against the recorded architecture and parameter count.
release_gates.statement: The report names mobilenet_rate_optimized_last_fold.pt, but the file is absent and only one final-fold checkpoint was ever saved; no fold checkpoint or state dict exists.
release_gates.title: trained_weights_and_fold_checkpoints

release_gates.reopen_condition: Provide a locked offline environment with every wheel hash, one install/import digest, deterministic algorithms, the recorded seed and 4/1 threads, then reproduce one training step.
release_gates.statement: The exact Python 3.10.13/torch 2.2.2/torchvision 0.17.2 runtime is absent. Librosa, NumPy, SciPy and SoundFile versions and wheel hashes are not recorded, and deterministic algorithms were not enabled in the script.
release_gates.title: pinned_deterministic_runtime

release_gates.reopen_condition: Persist the exact feature cache with SHA-256/byte count, or pin the front-end implementation and reproduce the cache digest from the qualified corpus.
release_gates.statement: The 24x64 log-mel front end is documented, but no cache was persisted and no exact librosa/mel implementation, padding, normalization order or output digest is pinned.
release_gates.title: logmel_frontend_and_feature_cache

release_gates.reopen_condition: Freeze a permitted, multi-meeting, speaker-disjoint cohort with reviewed corpus/dictionary terms, checked syllable labels, language groups and source timestamps.
release_gates.statement: The historical cohort is one AMI EN2003a meeting with CMUdict-derived labels. AMI, annotation and CMUdict terms are unreviewed, and no independent meeting/accent/language coverage exists.
release_gates.title: rights_cleared_rate_cohort_and_labels

release_gates.reopen_condition: Reproduce the fixed five-fold protocol on the qualified cohort with a frozen scorer, baseline, fold stability, finite-output checks and adverse/missing/nonfinite controls.
release_gates.statement: No five-fold CV, baseline comparison, finite-output scan or adverse/missing control was reproduced. The recorded run was worse than the constant baseline, which is context only.
release_gates.title: reproduced_quality_and_control_results

release_gates.reopen_condition: Score the exact Rate-profile cases and measure target-device p95/p99, resource, thermal/energy and deadline behavior under paced playback.
release_gates.statement: No Rate-profile mapping, buffering, rate-change, unfamiliar speech/music/silence, rebuffer/drift, final-window, pause/filler or target-device timing evidence exists.
release_gates.title: rate_profile_and_target_device_timing

release_gates.reopen_condition: Open a separate versioned OFF-by-default provider intake with an exact asset descriptor, clean-install proof and independent exact-head review after every prior gate clears.
release_gates.statement: No provider, adapter, descriptor, registry/default/shared-build or CI change exists, and no release decision is available.
release_gates.title: off_by_default_provider_intake_and_release

Five fold state dicts, or one checkpoint plus a bit-exact retraining recipe, each with SHA-256 and byte count and a reviewed trained-weight license/terms decision.
A locked offline Python 3.10.13, torch 2.2.2, torchvision 0.17.2 and librosa/NumPy/SciPy/SoundFile runtime with wheel hashes, install/import digest and deterministic settings.
The exact persisted 24x64 log-mel feature cache with digest, or a pinned front-end that reproduces the cache digest.
A rights-cleared, multi-meeting rate cohort with reviewed AMI/annotation/CMUdict terms, checked syllable labels, language/speaker groups and source timestamps.
A reproduced five-fold CV with baseline, fold stability, finite-output, adverse/missing and nonfinite controls.
Exact Rate-profile mapping, duration, pitch/transient, buffering, condition, rebuffer/drift, final-window, pause/filler and target-device timing evidence.
A separate versioned OFF-by-default SDK provider intake with empty descriptor settings, no registry/default/shared-build change and independent exact-head review.

required_results: The exact torchvision 0.17.2 MobileNetV3-small source tree and a complete license/notice bundle.
All five fold checkpoints (or one checkpoint plus a bit-exact retraining recipe) with SHA-256 and byte counts.
A locked offline Python 3.10.13 / torch 2.2.2 / torchvision 0.17.2 / librosa runtime with wheel hashes.
The exact persisted log-mel feature cache or a pinned front-end whose output digest is recorded.
A rights-cleared, multi-meeting rate cohort with checked syllable labels and source timestamps.
A reproduced five-fold CV result with baseline, fold stability, finite-output and adverse controls.
Exact Rate-profile mapping, buffering, condition and speech-preservation evidence.
Target-device p95/p99 timing, resource and deadline behavior.
A separate OFF-by-default versioned provider intake and independent exact-head review.
